name: Synapse Room
description: Structure documentation for a Matrix room as returned by the Synapse Admin API

fields.name: joined_members
fields.description: Total number of joined members (including remote)

fields.name: joined_local_members
fields.description: Number of local members on this homeserver

fields.name: creator
fields.description: Matrix user ID of the room creator

fields.name: encryption
fields.description: Encryption algorithm in use (null if unencrypted)

fields.name: federatable
fields.description: Whether the room is federated to other homeservers

fields.name: public
fields.description: Whether the room is listed in the public room directory

fields.name: state_events
fields.description: Number of state events in the room

fields.name: forgotten
fields.description: Whether all local users have forgotten the room
